Design a simple training challenge on Strava that everyone could attend.
Strava is a social network for athletes. One of the many features is the ability to create a challenge for your friends to join. You can design a challenge that is simple and everyone can join. A good example would be to create a challenge for a 5K run or walk. The challenge could be to run or walk 5 kilometers in a certain time frame, such as a week or a month. You can also make the challenge more fun by adding a theme or a goal. For example, you could challenge your friends to run or walk 5 kilometers in a certain time frame while also raising money for a good cause. This would not only motivate your friends to participate, but also help a good cause.
